fusions.name: Felling Stamp
fusions.desc: Brings a hoof down on a target at or below 25% health for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Hewing Arc
fusions.desc: A hewing kick that deals 4 damage to everything in a 2-tile arc ahead of you. Each hit has a 20% chance of [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Woodcutter's Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Tree Over
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 12 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
